interpretation: All 238 NCA headers are valid and parseable with the owner's header_key. The ldn sysmodule is identified as title 0100000000000018, version 0x5c0004b0, NCA 755bcf33085ed666cbbcf34de83d1cb0.nca, a 556,544-byte program NCA whose section 0 is a 556,032-byte AES-CTR PartitionFS. The ldn meta NCA decrypts with key_area_key_application_00 and its CNMT confirms the title version and the program NCA's SHA-256, which matches the local file. The program NCA uses key generation 0x17 (23.0.0), which requires key_area_key_application_16. The owner's prod.keys file stops at key generation 0x14 (20.0.0), so the program key area and section cannot be decrypted. The dump is NCA-only, so package1 is not present. This is a concrete key-coverage and artifact gap, not a failure of the LDN advertisement decryption.
limitations: The firmware dump's version is owner-reported and folder-named 23.0.1; it was not independently verified with a firmware tool.
The title-ID mapping comes from a community list; the title ID itself is read from the NCA header.
Package1 is absent, so the warmboot direction cannot be analyzed from this dump.
No key values, decrypted NCA content, or proprietary firmware are recorded here.
No program-NCA content was decrypted; the ldn meta NCA/CNMT was decrypted for title version and hash verification.
redactions: Only one NCA filename is recorded, for the ldn identification.
The serial number is reduced to the prefix XTJ.
No decrypted NCAs, KIPs, NSOs, or package1 images are recorded.

metadata_analysis.method: The ldn meta NCA was decrypted locally with AES-ECB (key_area_key_application_00) for the key area and AES-CTR for its PFS0 section, then the CNMT was parsed.
metadata_analysis.result: The CNMT reports title 0100000000000018, version 0x5c0004b0 (1543505072), content type SystemProgram, one content entry, and the NCA SHA-256 755bcf33085ed666cbbcf34de83d1cb0f7ceaa0ebf7a106dfa54a2d54b193072. That hash matches the local NCA file exactly.
metadata_analysis.consequence: The metadata path is readable with the supplied keys, but the program NCA content still requires key_area_key_application_16, which is absent. The hash match confirms the local ldn NCA is intact and matches its metadata.
